description.en: The ID of the master instance.

description.zh: JSON格式的字符串，可以被解析为一个字符串数组。要部署策略规则的关联集群数组。
description.en: An array of JSON strings. The JSON strings in the array indicate the IDs of the associated clusters in which the policy instance is deployed.

description.zh:
规则治理动作，取值：

- deny：拦截违规部署
- warn：告警
description.en:
The action of the policy. Valid values:

*   deny: blocks deployments that match the policy.
*   warn: generates alerts for deployments that match the policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adcp deploy-policy-instance --policy-name ACKNoEnvVarSecrets --namespaces default --cluster-ids c1c731554c1ec4a1ca9bb690ff9ed0000 --policy-action warn --cluster-id c102fe5f1ee5d4c87a68121a77d8b0000 --region cn-hangzhou
